narrative.overview: The site reads like a curated case file: every section numbered 01–07, each number paired with an uppercase kicker and a hairline rule, a fixed vertical spine rail annotating the left margin on desktop, and a dark colophon footer closing the file. The voice is calm and scientific — Source Serif 4 prose carries the argument with capped measures, IBM Plex Mono delivers the evidence as data ladders, and Newsreader display type makes the hero-scale statements. One accent, Burnt Terracotta, signals action and current state; its scarcity is the point. Depth is tonal, never a resting shadow: a white card on cream, framed by hairlines. Rounded corners, gradients, gloss and any second accent color are rejected outright.
keyCharacteristics: Numbered sections (01 / KICKER ——— title) with a desktop spine rail
Sharp geometry everywhere: border-radius 0 is absolute
Single terracotta accent; voltage marks vs text accent are different values
Flat and tonal: 1px hairlines plus tonal steps; shadows only for overlays and quote cards
Four-family type system: Newsreader display, Source Serif 4 prose, IBM Plex Sans chrome, IBM Plex Mono data
Archive Cream light default with a full Newsprint Charcoal dark twin via html[data-theme]

rules.name: The Voltage Rule
rules.body: #D65A3A marks (dots, markers, rules, spine progress); #B8442A speaks on light; #E27A5F speaks on dark. Voltage never appears as small text on cream — it is a 3.5:1 mark by law.

rules.name: The Same-Value Rule
rules.body: Light .hairline-light and .surface-green are both #E2E8E2 on purpose: the line you rest on is the line you hover onto. Do not split them into two tokens.

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: Prose = serif, chrome = sans, data = mono, statements = Newsreader. Never cross a role; never set prose in mono or labels in serif.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels and figure blocks never carry a shadow. Lift (-2px) and tonal fill communicate hover; shadow is reserved for overlays and the quote cards.

dos: Do divide content with 1px hairlines (sage for structure, hairline-light for internals) and clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5rem) section rhythm
Do number every page/section head NN / KICKER + marker + rule via SectionHeader; one h1 per page
Do assign type by role: serif prose capped at 54–68ch, mono for data/dates/counts, uppercase tracked sans for labels/nav/buttons
Do use #B8442A for text/interactive, #D65A3A only for marks, #E27A5F for text in dark
Do build depth tonally: Paper White on Archive Cream inside a 1px frame; reserve shadow-lg for overlays
Do keep targets at least 44px (min-h-11) and honor prefers-reduced-motion
donts: Don't round anything — no radius on buttons, cards, inputs, images, avatars or badges
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, blur or decorative gloss
Don't add a second accent color; terracotta is the only signal (info/success/error are semantic states only)
Don't put #D65A3A on cream as text, or any accent text below WCAG AA contrast
Don't shadow content cards at rest, or lift them more than -2px on hover
Don't set prose in sans/mono, labels in serif, or uppercase the serif
Don't leave uncapped measures — leads 54ch, blog prose 68ch, pull quotes 36ch
